items: o Nano fertilizers, including innovations like Nano Urea (Urea Gold) and Nano DAP, were
approved in 2021 and launched in 2023. They utilize nanotechnology to enhance nutrient
absorption by plants, offering a more efficient and environmentally friendly alternative to
 Increased Efficiency: Nano fertilizers improve nutrient uptake and reduce wastage.
 Reduced Environmental Impact: Lower application rates minimize chemical runoff and
 Sustainability: A more eco-friendly solution for modern agriculture.
o India's IFFCO pioneered the technology, starting the first Nano Urea plant in Kalol, Gujarat.
These fertilizers offer a sustainable way to boost agricultural productivity while addressing
the challenges posed by conventional fertilizers.
